statement: A finite-time singularity of Calabi flow. Disproves Chen's smooth long-time existence conjecture for Calabi flow by constructing a smooth $`U(10)`$-invariant Kähler metric on $`\mathbb{CP}^{10}`$ whose flow develops a finite-time singularity. The metric lies in the Fubini–Study class, so the failure occurs even in a class containing a constant-scalar-curvature metric.
